candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: such Consumer of premises shall pay Service Line cum Development (SLD) charges at the time of registration of Renewable Energy System, equal to the differential amount of SLD charges between the capacity of the Renewable Energy System and the existing sanctioned load
candidate_clauses.topic: RE system may exceed sanctioned load, with SLD charges
candidate_clauses.note: Candidate conflict with UP Reg 5.1 (cap = 100% of contracted demand) in the sense of cross-state contrast, and with any reading of Rule 11 ROC that ties capacity to sanctioned load.
